main_text.p: vocatum , quòd procreet דרור libertatem omnibus mercatoribus.
דרא m. Contemptus, Dan.2. v.12. Fastidium, Nausea, Jes.6.24. Est forma זכרון.

דרב m. Stimulus,Aculeus,1.Sam.13.12. Plur. cum Cholem in medio, דרבנות Aculei, Eccl. 12.11. Proprie est Ferrum,ligno,quod מלמד dicitur,indicum. Unde apud Talmudicos, מלמד שבלע הדרבן Baculus, Stimulus qui absorpsit aculeum, id est, ferreum aculeum infixum habens, Kelim fol.17.
דרג f. Gradus,Gradatio praeceps, Praecipitium: בסתר המדרגה In latibulo præcipitii, Cant.2.14. Plur. המדרגות Præcipitia,Gradus, Ezech.38. v.20. Chaldæus, Turres.

דרך Calcavit, Conculcavit: Incesit, Procesit; Incessus enim est via Calcatio. Ad arcum relatum, est, Tendit, Intendit: Præt. דרך כוכב Procedet stella, Num.24.17. קשתו דרך Arcum suum tetendit, Psal.7.13. נת דרך Torcular calcavit,Thr.1.15. Hiph. הדריך Idem: Item Incedere fecit, Deduxit: והדריך Et dedu et[?], Jesa. 11.15. Infin. juxta Kimchium, את הדריכה Tempus calcandi eam, Jer.51.33. cum Chirek sub ה loco Pathach.

דרך c. Via,Iter: Mos,Ratio,Consuetudo: דרך נשים לי Consuetudo mulierum est mihi, Gen.31.35. בדרך מצרים Ratione Aegypti, Jes.10.24. Aff. לדרכו In viam suâ,Num. 24.24. Dual. מעקש דרכים Quàm perversus duabus viis, id est, huc illuc se flectens, Prov.28.6. Plural. דרכים Via, Deuter.28.7. Constr. בדרכי חשך Per vias tenebrarum, Prov.2.13. Aff. כדרכיו Secundum vias suas, Ezech.33.20.
מדרך m. Calcario, Vestigium: Constructus. עד־מדרך Usq; ad vestigium plantæ pedis, Deut.2.5.

page.notes: Running head and page number are printed. The Hebrew headwords and the Hebrew words in the entries are copied as printed; their vowel points are not clearly legible at this scan resolution. The word "Et dedu et" is printed with a gap and is probably "Et deduxet"; it is marked [?]. Long s has been rendered as s throughout (the printed "f" in Nausea, Jesa, Confuetudo, Præcipitii and similar words). The "K 3" signature is at the foot. The left margin shows only a faint speck and no text.
